name: STORAGE FULL
detailed_description:
The Distort Ocean has risen — and it's nearly swallowed the entire world.

Cities. Forests. Mountains. All gone beneath the tide.

Only the Scuba Species — amphibious lifeforms adapted for both land and sea — stand as humanity’s last hope.

They alone can dive deep enough to destroy The Wields, the true source of this creeping catastrophe... before it’s too late.

---

🕹️ WHAT IS STORAGE FULL?

STORAGE FULL is a 2D side-scrolling action game with a vibrant cartoon-inspired art style that shifts between bright and somber tones based on the environment.

You’ll play as Zuum, a Scuba Species operative equipped with two mysterious powers that affect enemies — and the battlefield — in radically different ways:

• Buffer: Uplift your enemies with pride and dignity… causing them to walk away peacefully and leave behind healing energy.

• Nerfer: Strip away their sense of self-worth — turning them into volatile vessels of self-destruction that explode violently upon defeat.

Whether you choose compassion or force, every decision shapes how you survive... and how much you lose along the way.

---

🎮 CURRENT FEATURES (EARLY ACCESS)

✓ 3 fully playable stages with unique environments and boss battles

✓ Central base zone for upgrades, mission prep, and NPC interaction

✓ 10+ story-driven NPCs with lore, quests, and branching conversations

✓ Upgrade system to enhance speed, stealth, and special abilities

✓ Enemy Codex to track The Wields and uncover world lore

✓ Save/load system

✓ Original soundtrack and full SFX design carried over from the demo

---

🔮 PLANNED FEATURES FOR FULL RELEASE

• 15 total stages — with new environments, mechanics, and bosses

• Expanded storyline with deeper lore about the Distort Ocean

• Additional NPCs, side quests, and moral branching paths

• Multiple endings based on gameplay decisions

• Enhanced visual polish and environmental storytelling

• No full voice acting — the story is delivered through immersive, expressive dialogue

---

🤝 WHY EARLY ACCESS?

We believe in building STORAGE FULL together with our community.

Early Access lets us test new mechanics, tune the difficulty, and shape the story direction based on what resonates most with real players.

You’re not just helping us — you’re helping the ocean remember what it means to fight back.

---

Swim with mercy. Strike with force.

The ocean is full — but you might be fuller.
